plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Transfer Pathway map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. This plan transcribes the first/default pathway, the Transfer Pathway to CSU Bakersfield, Bakersfield College portion ONLY (Terms 1-4). The same page's CSU Bakersfield continuation (Music - General Music Bachelor of Arts, 60 units, Terms 9-12) is a different institution's degree and is excluded. The program's other pathway, 'Music to CSU' (also printed at 60-63 units, 4 terms), is a further pattern for the same AA-T credential, not a separate degree, and is not collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-63 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 14-15.5 / 16 / 15. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4) and 'Area 2 : Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. MUSC B2 is printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; it is a named major course and is recorded with category 'major'. MUSC B7 (Applied Music) is printed in all four terms as the map's applied-lesson sequence and genuinely repeats; allow_repeated_courses is set for that course. MUSC B15, MUSC B4A, MUSC B15A, MUSC B4B and MUSC B15B each show a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View, and MUSC B7 (all terms), MUSC B4A, MUSC B15A, MUSC B4B and MUSC B15B each show a 'Corequisites' flag; the map does not print the specific prerequisite or corequisite courses, so none are recorded and the flags are disclosed on those course rows. General-education, ensemble, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map (including the Term 1 Audition Requirement) carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.' The map also prints the footnote: 'Ready for the next step? Make an appointment with an advisor to create a customized education plan.'
